docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Some forty fables and a hundred folk tales of the Kashmir valley, collected and retold by the missionary J. Hinton Knowles, with notes on Kashmiri customs (London, 1893). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Folk-tales Of Kashmir · Knowles, J. Hinton · 1893, 530 scanned pages. Published 1893; James Hinton Knowles died 1943; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
